description: Implementation of VertexArrayMtl class methods for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, handling vertex and index buffer streaming, conversion, and setup.

classes.name: VertexArrayMtl
classes.description: Class implementing vertex array object methods for Metal backend, managing buffers, state synchronization, and data streaming.

methods.name: StreamVertexData
methods.description: Streams vertex data into a buffer, handling format conversion and buffer allocation.

methods.name: GetIndexConvertedBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates size of index buffer after conversion, especially for unsupported index types.

methods.name: StreamIndexData
methods.description: Streams index data into a buffer, expanding unsigned byte indices to ushort if needed.

methods.name: GetVertexCount
methods.description: Calculates number of vertices in a buffer based on size, format, and binding.

methods.name: GetIndexCount
methods.description: Calculates number of indices in a buffer based on size and index type.

methods.name: SetDefaultVertexBufferLayout
methods.description: Sets default layout parameters for vertex buffer.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffers and state for VertexArrayMtl.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes vertex array state with GPU buffers and attributes.

methods.name: setupDraw
methods.description: Prepares vertex description for drawing, updating buffers and layouts.

methods.name: updateClientAttribs
methods.description: Updates client-side vertex attributes into GPU buffers.

methods.name: syncDirtyAttrib
methods.description: Synchronizes individual attribute state, handling buffer conversion if needed.

methods.name: getIndexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or streams index buffer, converting if necessary.

methods.name: convertIndexBuffer
methods.description: Converts index buffer to supported format, possibly on GPU.

methods.name: streamIndexBufferFromClient
methods.description: Streams index data from client memory into GPU buffer.

methods.name: convertVertexBuffer
methods.description: Converts vertex buffer to tightly packed format, GPU or CPU based.

methods.name: convertVertexBufferCPU
methods.description: Performs CPU-based vertex buffer conversion to tightly packed format.
